          title: First name

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin

          title: Address

          type: string
          minLength: 1

          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number

            a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits; this
            E.164 value is stored and returned. For example '0412 345 678' is
            stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-

          type: string
          format: email

          maxLength: 255

            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already

          example: George
        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"

        city:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits; this
            E.164 value is stored and returned. For example '0412 345 678' is
            stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:

          format: email
